title: World's First AI Game Kebabstar [On Early Access and Development]
author: Novel-Common9013
selftext:
Nobody believed in 2022 that games could be made with AI, but...   
  
WE DID IT GUYS!

This game gonna be wild!

BUY KEBABSTAR NOW ON STEAM!
